plays_when: In The Bounds of Truth (Pharos - Second Ascent), at most once in a game: when the party frees the dais by lifting an altar's seal. The map has four stone altars; touching one whose seal is off seals it, with a line such as "Steel avails you not.", and sets the altar's bit and bit 0x10 of global byte 0x933; while bit 0x10 is set, up to story counter 6000 (After Vaan on the ship), the dais answers "Nothing happens. This chamber appears to be affecting the dais."; touching a sealed altar ("Strong magicks emanate from the altar." then "Touch the altar.") lifts its seal and clears both bits (rbl_j02 lines 2611, 2617, 2625, 2866 and 1678). The lifting runs the director's preload, which reads the scene into slot 0 and starts it, held on scratch 0x14, while bit 0x20 of the same byte is clear, the preload's own guard is 0 (it sets it to 1) and the party did not come in at entrance 1, the way in from Reach of the Damned (Pharos - Second Ascent) (map-link table); and then, with bit 0x20 still clear, frees the dais: it sets bit 0x20, releases the scene, waits for it to end and preloads dgl_a0101, and up to story counter 6000 (After Vaan on the ship) ends with "Your abilities are again your own." (rbl_j02 lines 754, 756, 758, 759, 761, 762, 990, 997, 1003, 1009, 1700, 1701, 1702, 1713, 1714, 1720 and 1723; the four altars' talks at rbl_j02 lines 2878 and 3074, 3484 and 3680, 4090 and 4286, 4696 and 4892). Of the field maps, only this release sets bit 0x20 and no field map clears it; the developer test maps evt_t0086 and evt_t0505 also set it, and evt_t0086 clears it.

plays_when: In The Bounds of Truth (Pharos - Second Ascent), at most once in a game: on a ride of the dais, up to story counter 6000 (After Vaan on the ship). The scene is read into slot 1 and started, held on scratch 0x14, at the end of the dais's freeing (after dgl_a0100), or by the director's preload on a later lifting of a seal (while its guard is 0), while bit 0x20 of global byte 0x933 is set, bit 0x80 clear and the counter at most that, unless the party came in at entrance 1, the way in from Reach of the Damned (Pharos - Second Ascent) (map-link table) (rbl_j02 lines 764, 766, 767, 1030, 1037, 1713 and 1714). At the dais ("Select destination: [value]F (Current location: [value]F)"), when bit 0x10 is clear, bit 0x80 is clear, the counter is at most 6000 and the chosen floor is not the current one, the talk releases the scene and starts the ride, which waits for it to end, sets bit 0x80 and takes the party to Reach of the Occult (Pharos - Second Ascent), field 1105 (lines 1407, 1669, 1670, 780, 781, 782 and 912). Of the field maps, only this ride sets bit 0x80 and no field map clears it, so in play a ride that sets it before the scene has been preloaded leaves the scene unplayed for good; the developer test maps evt_t0086 and evt_t0505 also set it, and evt_t0086 clears it.
